text: Hello, neighbours! I keep bees, so I know the apple trees well: every spring my hives hum through the blossoms, and that's why the orchard's apples come out so sweet. The trees I passed this morning were heavy with buds. A good orchard and a good hive need each other, and I love tending both.
speaker: ada

text: Um... hello. I like the pond best when it's quiet, just before the village wakes up. The water holds the sky so still that you can almost hear it. I brought my music here once, and the ripples seemed to keep time. That's all, thank you.
speaker: bo
